"""Verify the new actual Nix CLI against all six complete original source outputs."""
import gzip,hashlib,json,subprocess,unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem')
source=root/'docs/present-prefinal-source-discovery.json.gz'
output=Path('/tmp/klem-present-prefinal-packaged-cli.json')
assert not output.exists()
capture=json.loads(gzip.decompress(source.read_bytes()))
cli=Path('/nix/store/wkgaf7karm45jphbjx5bjy9i3jk941wh-klem-0.1.0/bin/klem')
old=Path('/nix/store/6byl3ach42phlrbg2s943lmb11fjkrdv-klem-0.1.0/bin/klem')
db=root/'data/dictionaries/krdict/krdict.db'
def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1048576),b''):h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
frozen={str(p):sha(p) for p in [cli,old,db]}
assert frozen[str(old)]==capture['frozen_inputs'][str(old)]
assert frozen[str(db)]==capture['frozen_inputs'][str(db)]
assert frozen[str(cli)]==frozen[str(old)]
runs=[]
for run in capture['runs']:
    text=unicodedata.normalize(run['encoding'],capture['input'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==run['input_sha256']
    command=[str(cli),*run['stages']['after']['command'][1:]]
    result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,input=text.encode(),capture_output=True,check=True)
    assert result.stdout.decode()==run['stages']['after']['jsonl']
    frames=[json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
    assert len(frames)==134
    runs.append({'encoding':run['encoding'],'mode':run['mode'],'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'records':len(frames),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),'input_sha256':run['input_sha256'],'exact_archived_output':True})
assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in frozen.items())
producer=Path(__file__)
report={'schema_version':1,'state':'passed','exit_code':0,'source_capture_sha256':sha(source),'new_package':str(cli.parent.parent),'frozen_inputs':frozen,'inputs_unchanged':True,'new_cli_identical_to_original_tested_cli':True,'runs':runs,'producer':{'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':sha(producer)},'scope':'Six actual packaged source streams, NFC/NFD and raw/headword/compatible, exactly reproduce the full archived outputs. The new packaged CLI bytes equal the original tested CLI. This verifies finite source/runtime parity, not contextual certification or all-candidate precision.'}
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Actual new Nix CLI: six exact 134-frame source streams; byte-identical to the original tested CLI.',flush=True)
